spell.name: Call Mascot

components.m: an item representing a specific college or the university

entries: You summon a fey spirit to an unoccupied space within range. It takes the form and uses the stats of one college mascot of your choice, based on what material component you use. You can use a {@item Strixhaven Pennant|SCC|college specific pennant}, a {@item Cuddly Strixhaven Mascot|SCC|cuddly college mascot}, or another item that best represents a college to summon a specific mascot. Additionally, if you use an item with the Strixhaven University symbol, a random mascot will be summoned to you instead. The mascot disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The mascots are listed below with their associated college.

The mascot is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the mascot shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge} action and uses its move to avoid danger.
